title: 第18章 嫂子刚洗完澡，你闻闻香不香？
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
刘美玉提前给李大壮留好了门，李大壮直接冲进院子，就看见刚洗完澡的刘美玉，一头乌黑的长发还湿哒哒的垂在雪白的肩膀上，身上穿着一条吊带紫色蕾丝花边睡裙。

    紫色不但很有女人味，还非常衬肤色，刘美玉露出来的肌肤都在月光的照映下，透着细腻的白。

    因为此时她正弯腰看向地上的大盆，本就低垂的衣领，垂的更低了，露出里面没穿胸罩的半片雪白，跟着刘美玉的动作自然下坠，像是两滴莹白的水珠，悬挂在刘美玉身前，惹人怜爱向往……

    “大壮！你还傻看啥呢？赶紧来看看你这个大老鳖咋回事啊！？”

    刘美玉听见声音，一看是李大壮来了，连忙快步走过去，拉着李大壮的手就往大盆那边拽。

    刘美玉的手特别柔软细腻，随着走动扭来扭去的屁股，壮观圆润，刚洗完澡的身子，还散发着一股淡淡的沐浴露香味，混合着她自己特有的女人香……

    李大壮刚才跟秋霜姐折腾半天，却没能得到释放的火苗，再次升腾起来！

    不过眼下还是先救老鳖要紧，李大壮压下体内燥热，连忙查看起盆里的老鳖。

    “我洗澡前这东西还睁着俩眼睛看呢，等我洗完澡出来，它就闭了眼睛，一动也不动了，我戳它鳖壳，它都没反应！”

    “大壮，它不会是死了吧？”刘美玉的美眸里全是担忧和内疚：“也不知道死了还值钱不？都怪我没照看好它，要是活着卖掉，你就能赚到钱补贴家用了！”

    “嫂子，不用自责，这玩意儿死了也能卖钱！”李大壮心里也没底，但还是笑呵呵的安慰刘美玉：“况且要不是你，我也抓不到这宝贝啊！”

    刘美玉闻言心里舒坦多了，美眸里的担忧化成了点点情丝，水波荡漾的看着李大壮：“傻小子，就你会安慰嫂子！”

    这么贴心的男人，说啥也让他成为自己的男人！

    “我可不是安慰嫂子，是这大老鳖，压根就没死！”李大壮刚才忽然心念一动，感知到老鳖只是晕倒了，并没死。

    正好之前在家趁着饭前的功夫，修炼了一会儿，现在体内多了些真气，李大壮便对准老鳖头，将真气输给了这家伙！
content_en:
Liu Meiyu left the door open for Li Dazhuang in advance. Li Dazhuang rushed into the yard and saw Liu Meiyu who had just taken a shower. Her long black hair was still wet hanging on her white shoulders. She was wearing a purple lace nightgown with suspenders.

    Purple is not only very feminine, but also matches the skin tone very well. Liu Meiyu's exposed skin is shining with delicate whiteness under the moonlight.

    Because at this time she was bending over to look at the big basin on the ground. The already low-hanging collar dropped even lower, revealing half of the white part of her body that was not wearing a bra. Following Liu Meiyu's movements, it naturally fell down, like two drops of crystal-white water hanging in front of Liu Meiyu's body, causing people to love and yearn for her...

    "Da Zhuang! What are you looking at? Come and see what's going on with you, a big old turtle!?"

    Liu Meiyu heard the sound and saw that Li Dazhuang was coming. She quickly walked over, took Li Dazhuang's hand and dragged him towards the basin.

    Liu Meiyu's hands are particularly soft and delicate, and her butt is swaying as she walks, which is magnificent and round. Her body, which has just been bathed, still exudes a faint fragrance of shower gel, mixed with her own unique feminine fragrance...

    Li Dazhuang had been tossing with Sister Qiu Shuang for a long time, but failed to release the flames, which rose again!

    However, it was still important to save the old turtle first. Li Dazhuang suppressed the heat in his body and quickly checked the old turtle in the basin.

    "Before I took a bath, this thing kept its eyes open. When I came out from the bath, it closed its eyes and stopped moving. I poked its shell, but it didn't respond!"

    "Dazhuang, isn't it dead?" Liu Meiyu's beautiful eyes were full of worry and guilt: "I don't know if it is worth anything after it is dead? It's all my fault for not taking good care of it. If it is sold alive, you can make money to support your family!"

    "Sister-in-law, don't blame yourself, this thing can be sold even if it's dead!" Li Dazhuang was unsure, but he still comforted Liu Meiyu with a smile: "Besides, if it weren't for you, I wouldn't be able to catch this treasure!"

    Liu Meiyu felt much more comfortable after hearing this, and the worry in her beautiful eyes turned into a little bit of love. She looked at Li Dazhuang with rippling eyes: "Silly boy, you are the only one who can comfort my sister-in-law!"

    Such a caring man, no matter what you say, he will be your man!

    "I'm not comforting my sister-in-law. This big old turtle is not dead at all!" Li Dazhuang suddenly had a thought in his mind just now and sensed that the old turtle just fainted and was not dead.

    Just before, he took advantage of the time before dinner at home to practice for a while. Now that he had more energy in his body, Li Dazhuang aimed at the old turtle head and lost his energy to this guy!
title_en: Chapter 18 My sister-in-law has just taken a shower, do you smell the fragrance?
